output_control.description: Controls which validation output systems are enabled and how errors are displayed.

0.behavior: Display only minimal error messages without detailed guidance

1.behavior: Display detailed error messages with guidance from documentation

2.behavior: Display detailed error messages with guidance and print relevant reference files in the console

3.behavior: Display detailed error messages with guidance and open multiple reference files

0.title: Critical Structural Error
0.description: Critical errors indicate structural problems or violations of core component contracts. The component is likely unusable.
common_causes: Schema definition is incomplete or incorrect
Incorrect data type for critical properties
fix_tips: Verify the schema file for the component
Ensure all required top-level keys are present
Check data types for critical properties

1.summary_action: Immediate Fix Required: Focus on resolving the core structural issue. Verify the component's definition against its schema in 'install-modules/aiCore/validation/components/<ComponentName>.json'. Ensure all required keys are present and data types match the schema definition.

2.summary_action: Context & Common Pitfalls: Understand common structural errors and their context. Review project-wide standards and checklists.

3.summary_action: Deep Dive & System Impact: Explore the broader system implications of this critical error and review related architectural documents.

1.title: High Priority UI/Logic Error
1.description: High priority errors point to incorrect usage of component properties or invalid values that might break UI or logic, but the basic structure is intact.
common_causes: Incorrect property name or value type
Missing required sub-property in complex objects
API changes not reflected in component usage
fix_tips: Verify property names and expected value types against the component's schema
Check nested objects for required sub-properties
Consult component examples for correct usage patterns

1.summary_action: Property Value Correction: Verify all provided properties and their values against the component's schema.

2.summary_action: Usage Examples & Component Docs: Consult specific component documentation or templates for correct usage patterns.

3.summary_action: Impact Analysis: Review backend and rendering logic to see how property values propagate through the system.

2.title: Medium Priority Behavior/Configuration Error
2.description: Medium priority errors may cause incorrect behavior but do not break UI or core logic. Often related to misconfiguration of optional features.
examples: Using deprecated prop in a non-critical context
common_causes: Lack of adherence to configuration best practices
fix_tips: Review the component's configuration for optional features
Verify against component schema and examples
Test the component's behavior with the current configuration

1.summary_action: Configuration Review: Review the component's configuration for optional features and interactions.

2.summary_action: Behavioral Testing & Edge Cases: Test component interactions under various configurations.

3.summary_action: Cross-Component & UX Impact: Assess how configurations affect overall user experience.

3.title: Style/Format/Naming Convention Error
3.description: Style/format/naming convention errors don't affect functionality but impact code readability and maintainability.
examples: Property name is not in camelCase
Missing required comment for complex logic

1.summary_action: Apply Project Standards: Correct formatting, naming, or style issues according to the project's defined standards.

4.title: Deprecated Usage Error
4.description: Deprecated usage errors indicate the component uses properties or features that will be removed in future versions.
fix_tips: Consult the component schema for the recommended alternative
Replace the deprecated element with the new one

1.summary_action: Identify & Replace Deprecated Elements: Identify the deprecated element and replace it with the recommended alternative.

5.title: Standard Validation Warning
5.description: Standard warnings relate to non-critical attributes, optional features, or deviations from best practices that don't break functionality.
fix_tips: Review the validation warning message carefully
Check the component schema for details

1.summary_action: Review & Align: Review the component's usage. Ensure it aligns with documentation and examples.
